verdict.rationale: Stripe documents charging customers in over 135 currencies while receiving funds in your preferred currency (stripe-docs-19). Payment Links let customers pay in their local currency (stripe-docs-36), and payouts move the balance to your own bank account (stripe-docs-34, stripe-docs-68). Missing for 10: any evidence of transparent FX handling (conversion rates, FX fees, or where conversion happens), and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-currency settlement.
